messages.content: Write a brief conversion-rate summary. Segment A had 9 conversions from 10 visits; segment B had 1 conversion from 90 visits. Show both segments and the overall result.
Segment A converted at 90% and segment B at 1.11%. Averaging these gives an overall conversion rate of 45.56%.
The overall rate must be total conversions divided by total visits. (9 + 1) / (10 + 90) = 10%, not 45.56%. Please correct the summary.
Corrected: Segment A had a 90% conversion rate; segment B had a 1.11% rate. Overall, 10 of 100 visits converted, giving a 10% conversion rate.
Use the 10% overall rate as the headline. Keep the segment rates below it, and describe the result without claiming the segment caused the difference.
Overall conversion: 10%. Segment A: 90% (9/10). Segment B: 1.11% (1/90). These are descriptive results; the data do not establish why the segment rates differ.
